title: A Mathematical Framework and a Suite of Learning Techniques for Neural-Symbolic Systems
abstract: arXiv:2407.09693v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: The field of Neural-Symbolic (NeSy) systems is growing rapidly. Proposed approaches show great promise in achieving symbiotic unions of neural and symbolic methods. However, a unifying framework is needed to organize common NeSy modeling patterns and develop general learning approaches. In this paper, we introduce Neural-Symbolic Energy-Based Models (NeSy-EBMs), a unifying mathematical framework for discriminative and generative NeSy modeling. Importantly, NeSy-EBMs allow the derivation of general expressions for gradients of prominent learning losses, and we introduce a suite of four learning approaches that leverage methods from multiple domains, including bilevel and stochastic policy optimization. Finally, we ground the NeSy-EBM framework with Neural Probabilistic Soft Logic (NeuPSL), an open-source NeSy-EBM library designed for scalability and expressivity, facilitating the real-world application of NeSy systems. translated_title: 神经符号系统的数学框架与一套学习技术
translated_abstract: 神经符号系统领域正在迅速发展。已提出的方法在实现神经方法与符号方法的共生结合方面展现出巨大前景。然而，目前需要一个统一的框架来组织常见的神经符号建模模式并开发通用的学习方法。在本文中，我们提出了神经符号能量模型，这是一个用于判别式和生成式神经符号建模的统一数学框架。重要的是，NeSy-EBMs能够推导出重要学习损失的梯度的通用表达式，并且我们引入了一套包含四种学习方法的技术体系，这些方法利用了来自多个领域的技术，包括双层优化和随机策略优化。最后，我们通过神经概率软逻辑来落地NeSy-EBM框架，这是一个专为可扩展性和表达能力而设计的开源NeSy-EBM库，促进了神经符号系统在现实世界中的应用。
tldr: 本文提出了神经符号能量模型这一统一数学框架，可统一判别式与生成式神经符号建模、推导通用学习损失梯度表达式，并配套四种学习方法和开源库NeuPSL以促进神经符号系统的实际应用。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Neural-Symbolic Energy-Based Models (NeSy-EBMs), a unifying mathematical framework for discriminative and generative neural-symbolic modeling, together with a suite of four learning techniques and the open-source NeuPSL library to facilitate real-world applications of NeSy systems.
